# Atlas CLI Scripting — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Atlas CLI Scripting. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] Scripts can request JSON output or extract fields using JSONPath and Go templates. JSONPath expressions must match the command response structure; inspect full JSON before selecting fields. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/custom-output-cli.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-env-variables.md

## How it works

- [statement] MongoDB recommends redirecting stderr to a separate file because errors and deprecation warnings can disrupt scripts expecting particular output. That file also provides warnings to review when maintaining scripts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-automate.md

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use --output json for machine parsing, or JSONPath and Go templates to select fields; an implementation tutorial extracts returned identifiers with jq and passes them into later Atlas and AWS commands. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/custom-output-cli.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://dev.to/rizasaputra/securely-exporting-mongodb-atlas-snapshots-to-s3-over-aws-privatelink-37m4

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Temporary-project deletion can fail with CANNOT_CLOSE_GROUP_ACTIVE_ATLAS_CLUSTERS while a cluster is still shutting down. The tutorial instructs waiting five minutes and retrying project deletion, then checking the project list. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md
- [statement] MongoDB recommends writing scripts against a tested CLI version, reviewing release notes before upgrades, and replacing deprecated commands. Its GitHub Action defaults to the latest CLI and offers a version input, so reproducible workflows need an explicit version choice. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-automate.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The snapshot-export implementation tutorial composes Atlas CLI and AWS CLI commands, saves JSON responses, extracts role and endpoint identifiers with jq, and checks endpoint status before configuring dependent resources. It is an example workflow rather than evidence that arbitrary reruns are idempotent. (low confidence) — https://dev.to/rizasaputra/securely-exporting-mongodb-atlas-snapshots-to-s3-over-aws-privatelink-37m4

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas CLI commands can be composed into scripts to manage Atlas resources; keeping provisioning commands in version control makes the chosen cluster configuration reviewable and repeatable. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-automate.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] For unattended scripts, service-account client ID and client secret can be supplied through MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_ID and MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET. The official Action demonstrates mapping repository secrets to these variables; API-key variables are another supported option. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-env-variables.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md, https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
- [statement] Configuration environment variables override stored profile settings. An explicit --projectId overrides both the environment variable and profile. MongoDB warns against mixing MongoDB CLI and Atlas CLI environment-variable families. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-env-variables.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/connect-atlas-cli.md
- [statement] MongoDB recommends building scripts against the installed Atlas CLI version, avoiding automatic CLI upgrades inside scripts, and reviewing release notes for breaking changes and deprecations before upgrading. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-automate.md
- [statement] Prisma's provisioning guide follows atlas clusters create with atlas clusters watch to wait for cluster readiness before subsequent use. (low confidence) — https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] Temporary-environment automation can create a project and cluster, expose a connection string to tests, then delete the cluster and project; both MongoDB's tutorial and its official GitHub Action document this lifecycle. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
- [statement] The official Atlas CLI GitHub Action README states that it defaults to the latest CLI, accepts a version input, officially supports only the latest version, and supports only Linux runners. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
- [statement] A January 20, 2026 issue reports HttpError: Bad credentials while atlas-github-action@v0.2.0 invokes oprypin/find-latest-tag@v1 to discover an Atlas CLI release. The reporter says this occurs before CLI installation, so the report does not establish an Atlas API authentication defect. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action/issues/30
- [statement] Atlas management credentials and database-user credentials serve separate purposes: automation needs control-plane authentication, while database users created by provisioning commands authenticate application or shell connections to the database. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] Atlas CLI supports scripting Atlas control-plane operations. MongoDB documents automation workflows, and its official GitHub Action runs CLI commands in workflow shell steps. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-automate.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
- [statement] Test automation in a temporary project and cluster, then delete the cluster before the project. MongoDB documents this lifecycle, and the official Action supplies a setup-and-teardown example. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
- [statement] Independent hands-on examples show Atlas CLI bootstrapping local test environments with deployments setup, --type local and --force. Luke Thompson demonstrated this in June 2024; Franck Pachot used a pinned 1.41.1 binary in his May 2025 lab. These are historical examples, not verified current command contracts. (medium confidence) — https://medium.com/@luketn/mongodb-local-atlas-deployments-under-the-hood-225b1b685fb7 · keywords: Atlas CLI Scripting · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/indexing-for-new-use-cases-within-the-mongodb-document-model-tutorial-2hdm
- [statement] Luke Thompson reported Podman connection/authentication problems in his June 2024 local-deployment investigation and provided a machine-refresh workaround. His updated article points to a combined Atlas Local container, so the original two-container setup must not be presented as the current universal architecture. (low confidence) — https://medium.com/@luketn/mongodb-local-atlas-deployments-under-the-hood-225b1b685fb7
